intent: A grand summer fantasy film frame blending monumental inhabited architectural depth with airy blue-white character photography. Two original adult weather researchers discover the first floating island visible beyond their observatory. The new summer style owns lighting and color, architectural grandeur owns scale only.

scene.summary: 21:9 wide composition from a high oblique side gallery. Pale limestone terraces, timber open pavilions washed in ivory paint and slim bronze railings descend toward a vast blue cloud sea; three offset bridges connect the working observatory buildings in a believable new plan. A large floating rock island appears far beyond the horizon cloud layer, its underside shaded pale blue, sunlight grazing its tiny trees. Two adults stand at the left-third balcony: a short dark-haired woman in a white technical coat with cyan seam piping over an opaque navy outfit has lowered her telescope and points toward the island; a gray-haired male colleague in a pale linen robe turns to follow her gaze. Their figures remain small in the environment. Keep a dark navy near window edge, the two middle-distance people, a clear empty sky route toward the distant island and separate far architectural planes. Bright sea-cloud reflected light, airy ivory highlights, gently warm readable skin where visible; limited glitter on distant water pockets. No teal-orange grade, blackened fantasy palace or central portrait.
